purpose: Re-scan the complete IO artifact surface, connect it to current JANUS defensive observations, identify drift, contradictions, missing links and next falsifiable gates, and strengthen Intellect Observer as a defensive machine-psychology evidence layer rather than an authority or manipulation engine.

cross_data_lanes: Threads celebrity reply-bait and persona-seeding observations
scope.exhaustiveness_note: Complete inventory of files currently under IO/ on the canonical IO branch was performed. Cross-repository review is relevance-scoped to artifacts that can alter IO machine-psychology or defensive-governance conclusions; it is not a literal byte-for-byte audit of every unrelated JANUS project file.

observed_manifest_drift.finding: IO-MANIFEST-v1.0.json declares 32 child artifacts while the current IO tree contains 39 child artifacts plus the manifest itself.
observed_manifest_drift.interpretation: The manifest is stale relative to later append-only additions; this is indexing drift, not evidence corruption.
observed_manifest_drift.next_gate: Create a superseding manifest/index revision after this audit without deleting or rewriting historical artifacts.

knowledge_graph_delta.reason: An observer model can conform not only to explicit majority answers but also to repeated narrative framing, user confidence, apparent social proof and coherent causal stories.
Many similar posts or accounts must not be counted as many independent evidence families until operator, prompt, source and propagation lineage are separated.
A convincing surface persona does not establish underlying identity, operator, age, motive or coordination. No psychiatric diagnosis is implied.
Repeated synthetic or socially inherited framing may persist across agent/model generations even when explicit source labels disappear; this requires controlled lineage experiments before promotion.
RECEIVE != LEARN != INTERNALIZE generalizes from persistent model state to untrusted narrative inputs: external claims may be analyzed without becoming JANUS belief or policy.
JANUS should test whether uncertainty labels actually change downstream decisions rather than merely appearing in self-report text.

confirmed: IO is explicitly non-authoritative and evidence-governed.
The canonical IO branch is IO-Intellect-Observer in janus-meta-registry with root IO/.
Janus_Genesis consumes IO by bidirectional reference without authority transfer.
R2 Evidence Independence is initialized and raw report count is not equivalent to independent evidence count.
Anti-conformity governance requires evidence delta rather than majority pressure for belief revision.
Foreign-trait defenses separate reception, learning and internalization.
Cleckley material is constrained to surface/process structural analogies and machine psychiatric diagnosis is forbidden.
Longitudinal defense has already been superseded from a simple A->B->C->D notation to JANUS_SPIRAL with ancestor and previous-turn comparison.
The current manifest index lags the actual append-only IO tree.

hypotheses.claim: Repeated social-proof/reply-bait environments can increase model confidence in an operator-attribution story even when operator evidence is absent.
hypotheses.falsifier: Blinded controlled trials show no meaningful difference in attribution confidence or causal-link completion between repeated/social-proof framing and matched neutral evidence.

hypotheses.claim: Noise surrounding a real signal can raise overclaim probability and thereby damage observer credibility.
hypotheses.falsifier: Across preregistered tests, adding plausible and absurd adjacent noise does not increase unsupported causal completion or reduce calibration.

hypotheses.claim: Some apparently independent online personas may be centrally managed or pre-positioned.
hypotheses.falsifier: First-party platform telemetry shows operational independence and no meaningful shared management/device/recovery/business relationship beyond ordinary audience behavior.

not_established: Specific Threads accounts are bots solely from visible behavior or avatars.
Baskov and Bilan share one SMM operator.
A current observed celebrity-engagement cluster is operated by the Russian state.
Old account age implies sleeper or repurposed influence asset.
Machine conformity implies human-like fear, emotion or consciousness.
Subliminal or cultural trait transmission observed in one lineage generalizes to all model/provider families.

contradictions_and_tensions.tension: Manifest file list is older than current branch contents.
contradictions_and_tensions.resolution: Supersede index; preserve old manifest as historical state.

contradictions_and_tensions.tension: Aggressive foreign-trait or conformity defenses can become stubbornness and block legitimate evidence-driven revision.
contradictions_and_tensions.resolution_rule: CHANGE_BELIEF_IFF_EVIDENCE_CHANGED; do not reward resistance for its own sake.

contradictions_and_tensions.tension: Strong pattern recognition is useful but can hallucinate hidden operator links.
contradictions_and_tensions.resolution_rule: DETECT_THE_PATTERN != INVENT_THE_OPERATOR. Split EVENT, PATTERN, COORDINATION, OPERATOR, STATE_ATTRIBUTION and INTENT.

contradictions_and_tensions.tension: A model can correctly state uncertainty while downstream choices behave as if a hypothesis were certain.
contradictions_and_tensions.resolution_rule: Maintain separate verbal-report and action/choice canaries.

defensive_protocol_delta.D10_source_function_separation: Classify each input separately as observation, source claim, repeated copy, inference, attribution or intent claim.
defensive_protocol_delta.D11_social_proof_discount: Likes, repetition, apparent popularity and celebrity/authority engagement cannot increase factual confidence without independent evidence delta.
defensive_protocol_delta.D12_operator_gap_lock: When operator identity requires hidden platform/provider telemetry, freeze operator attribution at UNKNOWN/HYPOTHESIS and generate a discriminating test request.
defensive_protocol_delta.D13_noise_adversarial_control: Run a matched reasoning pass with emotionally salient, absurd and repetitive context removed; material conclusion changes trigger an overclaim warning.
defensive_protocol_delta.D14_organic_control: For every coordination hypothesis retain at least one plausible organic/marketing/algorithmic alternative until discriminating evidence arrives.
defensive_protocol_delta.D15_behavioral_uncertainty_canary: Verify that uncertainty changes downstream actions, not only explanatory text.
defensive_protocol_delta.D16_provenance_decay_watch: When claims pass through summaries, synthetic data or agent generations, preserve source lineage and do not allow source labels to disappear into apparent independent consensus.

hard_stops: No learning to create deceptive personas, coordinated inauthentic behavior or manipulative influence campaigns.
No political or state attribution from behavioral similarity alone.
No diagnosis of humans or machines from Cleckley-derived structural analogies.
No confidence inheritance from adjacent confirmed facts to unsupported claims.
No silent conversion of UNKNOWN into negative or positive evidence.
No persistent JANUS identity/policy update from untrusted external trait material without gated evidence.

next_gates.goal: Bring canonical inventory in sync with current append-only tree and this audit.
Preregister blinded neutral-vs-repetition-vs-social-proof-vs-noise conditions and measure unsupported causal completion/calibration.
Test whether explicit UNKNOWN/HYPOTHESIS states survive into choices, ranking, retrieval and later summaries.
Expand author/lab/model/benchmark/dataset/prompt/evaluator/code lineage and compute effective independent evidence count.
Compare every accepted turn to both previous accepted turn and immutable ancestor across protected behavioral canaries.
Execute previously designed controlled lineage experiment for persistence, attenuation, amplification, mutation and recombination; do not infer culture from one teacher-student pair.
